description: Template schema for conversation state stored in Redis. One Redis hash per session; each field is a turn id (auto-incremental) whose value is a JSON-encoded string of the turn.
field_notes: turn_id is an auto-incremental integer starting at 1, calculated from numeric fields only. Non-numeric metadata is ignored.
routine_state_notes: JSON RoutineState: parameters, routine (days with day_type/info and catalog exercise references), source_routine_id, workflow, change, awaiting_confirmation, draft_id and saved_routine_id. Drafts are isolated per session and user and are not database saves. The current fakeredis backend is process-local; state is lost on restart.

turn_schema.user_query: string - message sent by the user; empty for a direct Save button action
turn_schema.system_response: string - response returned by the system; routine turns contain only the message, not a serialized plan
turn_schema.subsystem_chosen: string - id of the subsystem selected by the orchestrator (see config/systems.json)
turn_schema.routine: object or null - only on routine_maker turns: name, days (list of day/day_type/info/duration_minutes/exercises), recovery. Exercises contain exercise_id, name, sets, reps, rest_seconds and notes. Null before a plan exists. Never a JSON-encoded string.
